findings.evidence: `Basic.lean:216 instance cwType_cwApproximation`. The only facts the proofs use are `isWeakHomotopyEquivalence_cwApproximationMap`, `exists_comp_homotopic` and `homotopic_of_comp_homotopic`. The same file already states `exists_homotopyEquiv_comp_homotopic` for arbitrary `a : C(A, X)`, `a' : C(A', X)`.
findings.fix: State the API generally, e.g. `def IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence.lift (hb : b.IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence) (a : C(A, X)) (φ : C(X, Y)) : C(A, B)` with `[CWType A]` and `b : C(B, Y)`, together with the comp/uniqueness/id/comp/homotopy-invariance/iff lemmas for arbitrary `a`, `b` (the iff also needs `ha`). Then derive the `cwApproximation` versions by specialising to `cwApproximationMap` via `cwType_cwApproximation`.
findings.issue: `cwApproximationLift`, `comp_cwApproximationLift_homotopic`, `homotopic_cwApproximationLift`, `cwApproximationLift_homotopic_of_homotopic`, `cwApproximationLift_id_homotopic`, `cwApproximationLift_comp_homotopic` and `isWeakHomotopyEquivalence_cwApproximationLift_iff` are stated only for `cwApproximation X x`/`cwApproximationMap`. Their proofs use only that the target map is a weak homotopy equivalence and that the source has CW type, so the arbitrary-space approximation (TauCeti#25497, same roadmap milestone) would have to prove them all again.

summary: The injectivity half of Prop. 4.22 and the uniqueness of CW approximations are stated at the right level, but the naturality and functoriality API is proved only for the concrete `cwApproximation X x`, even though every proof works for arbitrary CW approximations. This duplicates work the in-flight arbitrary-space approximation will need again.
